CANONICAL_THETA3_COMPRESSION.wedge_identity: v wedge a_1 wedge b_1 = v wedge (u+b_1) wedge b_1 = v wedge u wedge b_1
CANONICAL_THETA3_COMPRESSION.primary_definition: Theta_3(K)=[t1 t2 t3] det(K-t1 v v^*-t2 u u^*-t3 b_1 b_1^*)
CANONICAL_THETA3_COMPRESSION.sign_rewrite_note: No extra wedge sign appears in replacing a_1 by u+b_1 in the middle slot because v wedge (u+b_1) wedge b_1 = v wedge u wedge b_1.

FROZEN_TARGET.statement: Given the single exact surviving scalar Theta_3(K)=C3(v,u,b_1;K), determine whether the next actual HPS weighted suffix factor admits an exact r^O(1)-bit state and update sufficient to propagate its contribution toward sign Delta_s(z_r), stopping immediately at the first genuinely new higher-order statistic.

R3_RGE4_FACTOR_SPLIT.r_equal_3: tau23 completes the recursively generated S3 factorization on the current base edge; there is no tau14 same-edge factor.
R3_RGE4_FACTOR_SPLIT.r_ge_4: HPS recursion first generates the complete S3 prefix and then appends the r=4 star factors tau14,tau24,tau34. Therefore the next same-edge factor after tau23 is tau14.
R3_RGE4_FACTOR_SPLIT.derivation: HPS Remark 4.7 recursion: after a uniform S_{r-1} factorization, Y_j=(j r) with probability 1/(r-j+1). For the r=4 extension, j=1 gives tau14 with probability 1/4 before tau24 and tau34.

NEXT_HPS_FACTOR_SEMANTICS.proof_gate_obligation: Re-derive the exact common-middle branch convention and any residual-suffix transport needed for c_0,c_1 before using them in the C3 update.

SINGLE_WEDGE3_STATE.question: Does the next actual weighted HPS factor require more information than this one exact wedge^3 quadratic observable?
SINGLE_WEDGE3_STATE.ambient_dimension_note: dim wedge^3 C^{186(r-1)}=O(r^3), so fixed order 3 is polynomial-size and representation dimension alone is not a blocker.

CANDIDATE_WEIGHTED_UPDATE.next_update_question: Determine the exact coefficient identity for C3(v,u,b_1;K-c c^*) under c=c_0 and c=c_1 using the actual weighted tau14 common-middle semantics.
CANDIDATE_WEIGHTED_UPDATE.expected_coefficient_structure_to_verify: C3(v,u,b_1;K-c c^*) may equal C3(v,u,b_1;K)+C4(v,u,b_1,c;K) by direct coefficient extraction, but the future proof gate must verify the convention inside the exact HPS branch decomposition.
CANDIDATE_WEIGHTED_UPDATE.weighted_target: Combine the exact c_0 and c_1 branch updates with weights 3/4 and 1/4 without any uniform surrogate.

must_compute_exactly: all relevant Gram determinants for w_3 wedge c_0 and w_3 wedge c_1
ROOT_GEOMETRY_TESTS_TO_FREEZE.high_value_question: Does the Type-A root chain annihilate one or both candidate order-4 branch directions just as beta=alpha+gamma annihilated the u-side C3 term?

C4_DEFINITION_IF_NEEDED.activation_condition: Use only if the proof gate derives an actual surviving fourth mixed coefficient from the tau14 weighted update.
C4_DEFINITION_IF_NEEDED.stop_rule: If one or more exact C4 scalars are first required, freeze them and STOP; do not preregister or construct C5 in the same proof gate.

current_exact_evidence: C3 u-side direction vanished because u wedge a_1 wedge b_1=0
TYPE_A_ROOT_CHAIN_CANDIDATE.future_test: Check whether adding delta=(e1-e4)/sqrt(2) produces another exact branch-specific wedge dependence or annihilation.

REPRESENTATION_THEORY.partial_permutation_question: Can the exact one-dimensional/generated wedge^3 observable and its weighted next-factor image be represented in a polynomial-size exact partial-permutation module?
REPRESENTATION_THEORY.jucys_murphy_question: Can the exact tau14 weighted image of the concrete wedge^3 state be embedded in a polynomial-size exact star-transposition/Jucys-Murphy module?
REPRESENTATION_THEORY.forbidden_broadening: Do not ask whether representation theory solves the selector or whole sign oracle.

COMPLEXITY_FIREWALL.fixed_k_law: For fixed k, dim wedge^k C^{O(r)}=O(r^k).
COMPLEXITY_FIREWALL.danger_condition: Only a proved necessity for compound order growing unboundedly with r would threaten polynomial representation dimension.
COMPLEXITY_FIREWALL.bit_complexity_requirement: Every exact scalar/state coefficient and weighted update used by a future PASS must have polynomial bit length and r^O(1) bit-operation complexity.

PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.PASS_C3_WEIGHTED_UPDATE_CLOSED_WITHIN_OR: The actual next weighted HPS factor is handled exactly in r^O(1) bit complexity using an order-3 state, with no genuinely new higher-order statistic.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.PASS_C3_CHARACTERIZED_AND_FIRST_C4_SCALA: Theta_3 is propagated exactly through the concrete weighted next factor and the first exact surviving C4 scalar(s) are identified, after which the proof gate stops.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.OPEN_NO_PROOF_NO_FALSIFIER: The exact next weighted update remains unresolved and no rigorous falsifier of the entire local frozen target is obtained.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.FAIL: Only a rigorous falsifier of the entire frozen local C3 weighted-update target under the exact HPS semantics; failure of one state representation is not FAIL.
PASS_OPEN_FAIL_CRITERIA.post_pass_firewall: Neither PASS variant implies sign-oracle PASS, selector A, H1/H2/H3, SAT_IN_P, or P_VS_NP.

HRAIN_RED_TEAM.earliest_counterexample_rule: Prefer the first exact reachable HPS counterexample to a proposed state/closure claim over large empirical sweeps.

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.scope: Run only the local C3 next-weighted-update closure/falsification gate; stop at the first genuinely new higher-order statistic.
